seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Gretna, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Gretna, Louisiana for 2026: Lighting of the Oaks, Hope Haven train rides, Wego Winter Wonderland and Ideal Christmas Fest.
lede: Gretna celebrates Christmas along Huey P. Long Avenue in Historic Gretna, with an oak tree lighting, a Christmas market and a parade with a tree lighting.
celebrates: Historic Gretna turns Huey P. Long Avenue into the center of its holiday season. The Lighting of the Oaks opens the season on November 27, the Olde Gretna Christmas Market sets up at the Gretna Market Pavilion on Huey P. Long Avenue between 3rd and 4th Streets on December 5, and the Gretna Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting follows on December 6 from 5 to 7:30 pm along Huey P. Long Avenue. Ideal Christmas Fest adds an evening of Santa photos, music and gifts for kids at 1900 Lafayette Street on December 5. Nearby Terrytown library offers a Christmas gumbo cookie party on December 22.
lastyear: We did not find a sourced recap of Gretna's 2025 Christmas events for this page, so this section stays short. Check the City of Gretna website at gretnala.com for photos and notes from past years before you go.
facts: Historic Gretna's main street is Huey P. Long Avenue, which runs from 10th Street to the Mississippi River according to the live Lighting of the Oaks listing. Gretna sits across the river from New Orleans in Jefferson Parish. The Visit Jefferson Parish calendar lists Gretna events such as Ideal Christmas Fest.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Gretna itself. The nearest holiday train is THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride at New Orleans Union Passenger Terminal, 1001 Loyola Avenue in New Orleans, which runs December 11 to 31 except December 25, according to the New Orleans and Company tourism calendar. The Louisiana Steam Train Association and the New Orleans streetcars also have pages on our site.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Gretna for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events across Gretna and 3 nearby West Bank towns, at least 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Lighting of the Oaks) through December 22 (Kitchen Kids: Christmas Gumbo Cookie Party at the Terrytown Library), with the Plaquemines Christmas Festival and Parade (November 28), Christmas Tree Lighting at Hope Haven Fitness Trail with train rides (November 29), Ideal Christmas Fest (December 5) and the Gretna Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting and Wego Winter Wonderland (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Gretna

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Gretna, Terrytown, Marrero, Westwego and Belle Chasse
  • At least 4 free events, including Ideal Christmas Fest, the Hope Haven tree lighting, Wego Winter Wonderland and the Plaquemines Christmas Festival
  • Meet Santa: Ideal Christmas Fest (December 5), Wego Winter Wonderland (December 6) and the Plaquemines Christmas Festival (November 28)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Lighting of the Oaks (November 27), Plaquemines Christmas Parade (November 28), Hope Haven tree lighting (November 29) and the Gretna Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting (December 6)
  • Trains: train rides at the Hope Haven tree lighting in Marrero (November 29)
  • Season: November 27 to December 22

Planning a bigger day out? Gretna families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in New Orleans, which covers Celebration in the Oaks, THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride and the West End Christmas Boat Parade.
